# Lior Oren

Canonical URL: https://lioren.com/

## Roles

- CTO
- Board Advisor

## Summary

Lior Oren is a technology executive with 20+ years of leadership experience across venture-backed startups, scale-ups, and global technology companies including Meta, Wix, LivePerson, Jimdo, Seldon Digital, and Replika.

He focuses on technology strategy, product leadership, UX, organizational design, AI-native products, conversational AI, AI platforms, engineering effectiveness, enterprise modernization, and large-scale transformation.

Lior has built and scaled engineering organizations from founding teams to 70+ engineers and partners with CEOs, executive teams, boards, and investors through growth, transformation, technical and financial diligence, and AI adoption.

## Selected Experience

### Replika

CTO and executive team member. Led Replika's transition to a next-generation AI-first platform serving 40M+ users. Built the AI platform foundation, introduced multi-model architecture, rebuilt Engineering, MLOps and DevOps, reduced infrastructure costs by 22%, and led technical, financial, regulatory, and data diligence through company-wide restructuring.

### LivePerson

Director of Engineering. Led multiple engineering organizations building conversational AI products for Fortune 500 enterprises and SMBs, including AI copilots, conversation platforms, UX infrastructure, and cloud-native services.

### Meta

Engineering. Built products and engineering systems at global scale within one of the world's leading technology organizations.

### Wix

Engineering Leadership. Product engineering, platform development, engineering scale, and organizational growth in one of the world's leading SaaS companies.

### Seldon Digital

Chief Technology Officer. Led the transition to autonomous, spec-driven software delivery powered by AI agents while building the engineering organization and technology strategy.
